page.overview:
Who is Argus Veer?

Argus Veer was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Argus Veer was a renowned gladiator who was celebrated as the greatest in the Known Universe. He eventually retired to Grumman and did not fight for seven years, but returned when he was commissioned by Glossu Rabban to fight at a festival in Carthag on Arrakis.
